0022600114.text: The Knicks, 0-2 overall and 2.5 games back in the Atlantic, host the 0-2 Orlando Magic, who are 1.5 games back in the Southeast, in a matchup of two winless teams. Jose Alvarado is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision for New York, while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Anthony Black is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the Knicks winning the last meeting 132-120 in Orlando on December 13, 2025.
